items.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says

items.title: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC

items.title: Noel Fielding 'appalled' by jokes he made with Russell Brand

items.title: Thousands turn out in Edinburgh to protest against AI data centres

items.title: Even Grand Theft Auto's original creators haven't been able to play GTA 6
